raw:
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "查询所有有效订单的总销售额。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "计算 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的所有订单的 paid_amount 总和。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:sum:paid_amount:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT SUM(paid_amount) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有在售商品的名称和所属品类。",
      "category": "filtering",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "从 products 表中筛选 is_active = 1 的记录，返回 product_name 和 category 两列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "filtering:products:is_active:product_name_category",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT product_name, category FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "统计有效订单对应的付费用户数。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "统计 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单所关联的不重复 user_id 数量。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count_distinct:user_id:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS paying_users FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按城市分组，统计各城市有效订单的销售总额，并降序排列。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "联结 orders 与 users 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单按 users.city 分组，求 paid_amount 总和，并按该总和降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:city:sales_amount:orders_users:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "计算所有有效订单中每单平均购买数量。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对所有属于有效订单（order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')）的 order_items 记录，计算 quantity 的平均值。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:avg:quantity:order_items:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按品牌分组，统计各品牌在有效订单中的销售总额，并取前5名。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "联结 orders、order_items 和 products 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单按 products.brand 分组，求 item_amount 总和，并取前5名（按总和降序）。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:brand:sales_amount:orders_items_products:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计各品类的有效订单销售额及对应已批准退款金额。",
      "category": "join",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "联结 orders、order_items、products 和 refunds 表，按 products.category 分组，分别计算有效订单的 item_amount 总和与 refund_status='approved' 的 refund_amount 总和。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "join:category:sales_refund:orders_items_products_refunds:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.category;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "计算手机数码类商品的产品退款率。",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "计算手机数码类商品在有效订单中的销售总额（item_amount）与对应已批准退款总额（refund_amount）之比，即退款率。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "refund:rate:category:手机数码:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "统计各类已批准退款原因出现的次数。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对 refunds 表中 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，按 refund_reason 分组计数。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count:refund_reason:refunds:approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按月统计2026年各月有效订单的销售总额。",
      "category": "time",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 且 order_date 在2026年内的记录，按 YEAR(order_date) 和 MONTH(order_date) 分组，求 paid_amount 总和，并按时间升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "time:monthly:orders_sales:2026:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS year, MONTH(order_date) AS month, SUM(paid_amount) AS monthly_sales FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
